info.title: MAC
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

aged_on_subsystems.description:
Reference Resource: [Subsystem](#/Subsystem)
Each dataplane module will update this to indicate the inactivity for this MAC entry for the specified age time. Once all data plane modules have updated this, the entry can be removed from all the dataplane.

attributes.description: Various attributes associated with this MAC table entry.

l3_lookup.description: When set to true, MAC needs to be programmed as a router MAC address.

local_move_disable.description: When set to true the MAC address move is prevented, when set to false the move is permitted.

denied.description: if `true`, indicates that the packets from or destined to this MAC address needs to be dropped.

derived_entry_src.description: Indicates whether this MAC entry is derived from a certain 'original'  MAC address and the source that triggered creating this derived entry. `none`         - Original entry (not derived). `pvlan`        - Replicated entry by Private VLAN.

desired_l2_composite_group.description:
Reference Resource: [L2_Composite_Group](#/L2_Composite_Group)
L2 Composite Group corresponding to this MAC Entry. A L2 Composite Group is a composition of different types of l2 egress entities.

desired_l2_destination.description:
Reference Resource: [L2_Destination](#/L2_Destination)
Source of this MAC entry, as indicated by from column, specifies desired L2 Destination that it wants this MAC address to be associated with.

desired_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Source of this MAC entry, as indicated by from column, specifies the desired port [Port](#/Port) that it wants this MAC address to be associated with.

desired_tunnel_endpoint.description:
Reference Resource: [Tunnel_Endpoint](#/Tunnel_Endpoint)
Source of this MAC entry, as indicated by from column, specifies the desired tunnel_endpoint that it wants this MAC address to be associated with.

flex_filter.description: Show flex_filter information for this MAC/VLAN pair.

flex_entry_index.description: Assigned flex_entry_index value for this MAC/VLAN pair.

from.description:
Reference Resource: [MAC](#/MAC)
Source of the MAC address: `dynamic`: learnt by the data path `VSX`: synchronized from the VSX peer `static`: configured statically by the user `VRRP`: added by VRRP protocol `port-access-security`: added by Port Access Security. `evpn`: added by EVPN. `hsc`: added by a remote controller(e.g. NSX). `router-mac`: add a router MAC.

gbp_role_id.description: GBP role-id associated with this MAC entry. Non GBP clients use 0 as their role-id.

inactivity_timeout.description: Specifies the time in seconds after which the MAC entry has to be aged out for lack of activity.

l2_composite_group.description:
Reference Resource: [L2_Composite_Group](#/L2_Composite_Group)
L2 Composite Group corresponding to this MAC Entry. A L2 Composite Group is a composition of different types of l2 egress entities.

l2_destination.description:
Reference Resource: [L2_Destination](#/L2_Destination)
Specifies the L2 Destination on which this MAC address is associated. The value will be updated from desired_l2_destination, after the entry has been chosen to be installed in the dataplane associated with.

mac_addr.description:
Reference Resource: [MAC](#/MAC)
MAC address in a AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF form.

move_history.description: Specifies details of the last 10 mac moves.

previous_destination.description: Specifies the last destination names [Port/Tunnel] on which this MAC address was associated prior to its current destination.

previous_source.description: Specifies the last source [i.e. Dynamic/Static] this MAC address was associated prior to its current source.

timestamp.description: Specifies the last timestamp this MAC address was moved.

network_infra_mac.description: Set to 'true' if MAC address is determined to belong to network infrastructure device.

never_ageout.description: if `true`, indicates that MAC should never be aged out regardless of inactivity_timeout.

number_of_moves.description: A non-zero value indicates the number of times that the entry has been moved

port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Specifies the port [Port](#/Port) on which this MAC address is associated. The value will be updated from desired_port, after the entry has been chosen to be installed in the dataplane.

rapid_move_detection_details.description: Rapid move details associated with this MAC table entry.

rapid_move_counter.description: A non-zero value that keeps track of the number of moves within the rapid move detection end time. If this count reaches the rapid move detection counter, within the rapid move detection end time, then this entry will be detected as a rapid move and this counter will be reset for next rapid move detection.

rapid_move_end_time.description: Indicates the timestamp (in seconds from epoch) that defines the time interval for rapid move detection.

selected.description: If `true`, indicates that the MAC entry is selected for programming into the ASIC. If `false`, indicates that the MAC entry is not selected.

tunnel_endpoint.description:
Reference Resource: [Tunnel_Endpoint](#/Tunnel_Endpoint)
In case of multipoint tunnels, like VXLAN, tunnel_endpoint designates specific endpoint where the packets matching this destination MAC address should be forwarded to. The value will be updated from desired_tunnel_endpoint, after the entry has been chosen to be installed in the dataplane.

vlan.description:
Reference Resource: [MAC](#/MAC)
VLAN on which the MAC entry is established.

parameters.name: VLAN.id
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VLAN](#/VLAN)
The ID of this VLAN. Non-internal VLANs must have an 'id' between 1 and 4094 to be effectively instantiated.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
